description: Structural completeness audit of existing published Product Radar data, not a live check of merchants, counters or image URLs.
interpretation: No item has full proof of current demand plus verified China wholesale supplier plus complete unit economics. Observed marketplace purchase counters do not reveal a time period. URLs may be unavailable.
method: Counts of files in the repository; live availability is not checked.
display_policy: Never display the existing assortment as profitable or verified for procurement; merchants can be viewed for research.
